Groove Pool.notes: Reclassified 2026-08-07 (QA pass): only automation_id present is GroovePool itself (the section's own top-level group id); no child control carries a usable id (node_count=5, controls_with_automation_id=1). Same signature as the OPAQUE Max-for-Live devices, but OPAQUE per this catalog's schema means 'the whole device/panel is one element with no visible children' - Groove Pool has 5 real nodes, just none with ids, so UNMAPPED fits the schema better than OPAQUE. Originally merged as MAPPED because the section-based merge path (survey_section.py, unlike the per-device loop) didn't exclude the top-level group's own id from the 'real controls' count.
